# Velocity Vision

> Velocity Vision is self-serve B2B software: a commercial workspace where teams review their own authorised business data, prepare AI-assisted editable drafts, verify their own sender, approve activation themselves, and track replies, follow-up and early pipeline in one place.

Operated by Global Solutions Management LLC (Delaware, USA). Website: velocity-outreach.com

Velocity Vision is software, not an agency. It does not provide managed campaigns, PR, media buying or creative services; it does not scrape contacts or sell lists; it does not send anything automatically; and it does not guarantee compliance, deliverability, replies, pipeline or revenue. Customers supply their own lawfully obtained business data and remain responsible for lawful basis, sender identity, content review, suppression handling and every activation decision.
